north_star.description: Publish a concise standalone skill that preserves a parented outcome stack and prevents completion leakage.

delivery_stages.description: Release the backward-readable schema-v3 outcome-stack contract locally and on GitHub.

outcome_capabilities.description: Maintain explicit north-star, delivery-stage, capability, slice, and action levels with scoped corrections.
Prevent child evidence or status from satisfying, substituting for, or rewriting a parent without declared coverage.
Keep schema versions 1 and 2 readable for recovery while requiring schema 3 for new completion claims.
Keep the generic skill token-bounded, tested, valid, and idempotently installable.
Publish the exact verified source on GitHub main and as the latest v3.0.0 release.

identity_requirements.description: The standalone dont-x-smart-be-smart-skill source and installed outcome-integrity copy.

requirements.description: The generic instructions and schema enforce the parented outcome stack and typed completion.
requirements.proof_scope: Generic source assertions and adversarial validator fixtures cover parent integrity, cross-stage rejection, completion isolation, and v1/v2 recovery.
requirements.proof_limits: Deterministic contract tests cannot guarantee every probabilistic model response.

acceptance_steps.description: Require the five-level parented outcome stack and scoped correction propagation.
Reject unknown, cross-stage, and current-stage parent mismatches.
Reject stage and north-star completion without declared lower-level coverage.
Resume valid schema-v1 and schema-v2 state but reject new completion claims until migration.

evidence.summary: Twenty-nine deterministic tests pass, including cross-stage substitution, slice-to-stage leakage, premature north-star achievement, current-stage mismatch, and v1/v2 recovery.

requirements.description: The exact generic source passes every local gate and is installed idempotently without touching a plugin or application project.
requirements.proof_scope: Repository tests, official validation, compilation, project gates, isolated install, active install, and source hash comparison.
requirements.proof_limits: Local package proof does not establish GitHub publication or universal model behavior.

acceptance_steps.description: Pass repository tests, official skill validation, compilation, and project validation.
Install twice in isolation and into the active Codex home.
Verify exact source-to-installed file parity and one managed global rule block.
Verify generic sources contain no motivating plugin or provider identities.

evidence.ref: 29 deterministic tests; quick_validate.py; compileall; project validate/resume; isolated and active double-install; exact five-file SHA-256 comparison; one managed global rule block
evidence.summary: The generic schema-v3 package passed every local gate, installed idempotently, matched the active installed skill exactly, and kept motivating plugin/provider identities out of runtime sources.

requirements.description: GitHub main, public CI, tag v3.0.0, and the latest release identify the exact verified implementation.
requirements.proof_scope: GitHub commit, Actions, tag, and release metadata prove publication of the verified source.
requirements.proof_limits: Publication does not guarantee behavior in every future task.

acceptance_steps.description: Commit and merge the exact verified standalone source to GitHub main.
Confirm public validation passes for the merged implementation.
Publish v3.0.0 at the implementation revision and verify it is the latest release.

evidence.summary: PR 4 merged the verified implementation to main at 52e66b0393dc044554ac6d4a44668653a3a861da, public main CI passed, and GitHub reports the non-draft v3.0.0 release as latest with its tag resolving exactly to that commit.
